current_activity: ordered to attack south for a bridgehead about 1.5 miles deep south of Pont l'Abbé
notes: CMH (Harrison, ch. X): VIII Corps was to take control of the 82d, which "was ordered to attack south on 17 June to establish a bridgehead south of Pont l'Abbé about a mile and a half deep". This is an order; Harrison does not report the result. Point moved from La Haye-du-Puits (v1, about 11 km south) to the ground south of Pont l'Abbé: Les Moitiers-en-Bauptois centre is about 2 km south-southwest of the Pont l'Abbé hamlet (OSM), within the 1.5-mile depth. location_represents is now objective (the planned bridgehead), not front_line_point. Same area, later dates: Wikipedia puts the 507th's bridgehead over the Douve south of Pont l'Abbé on 19 June, and the 507th after-action report (scanned, OCR garbled) has its 1st Battalion crossing the swamp toward Vindefontaine (about 4.6 km south of Pont l'Abbé) on the night of 18-19 June; this row and C0141 may therefore be the order and its execution, and stay disputed. Documented elsewhere on 17 June: the 82d secured the causeway over the Prairies Marécageuses south of St. Sauveur-le-Vicomte by that night (Utah Beach to Cherbourg, ch. 8); that is about 7.5 km west and is not this row's point.
